subject: Compliance add-ons: packaging, credits, and evidence delivery for Careline
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@careline.health>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Careline Procurement <procurement@careline.health>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-ons: packaging and credits and evidence cadence

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Careline is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the residency options. Procurement asked me to follow up specifically on the compliance add-ons so we can move the commercial review forward. A few concrete asks: 

- Can you confirm the packaging options for audit logs / KMS / HSM (one-off implementation vs monthly recurring)?
- Do you have a standard credit schedule if we take a 12-month committed Dedicated pool (we're targeting a Q3 start)?
- What's your evidence delivery cadence for SOC2 artifacts and auditlog extracts during onboarding (we need to show this to IT security)?

If possible, please attach a short SOW stub and any sample crediting templates. Procurement would like a simple cost table and a recommended path (pilot -> scale) with the expected offsets.

Elena
Elena Soto
Sr. Procurement Manager | Careline Health
elena.soto@careline.health
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@careline.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: packaging, credits, and evidence cadence

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Putting answers below and attaching a short SOW + a SOC2 snapshot for your security team.

Quick summary (short/long):
- Packaging: modular. Audit logs (ingest + retention) billed monthly by GB; KMS managed key seats billed monthly per active key; optional HSM seat billed as an annual subscription (or amortized monthly) if you need customer-managed HSMs. Implementation (onboarding, tenant keying, ops playbook) is one-time professional services and can be applied as either an upfront fee or converted into credits spread over the first 12 months.

- Credit schedule: for a 12-month Dedicated commit we recommend a two-tier credit structure: a pilot onboarding credit (one-off, offsets PS fee) + a recurring monthly credit that scales with committed throughput. Example: 50% offset of PS fee for pilot + $X/month credit for first 6 months. We've attached a worked example in the SOW stub.

- Evidence cadence: SOC2 snapshot + policy docs are shared up front. For auditlog extracts we can provide weekly incremental exports during onboarding, then a retention/retrieval SLA (24–48 hours) once in steady-state. For HSM attestation and keying proofs we provide signed KMS logs and an HSM vendor attestation (where applicable).

I've looped in Ben (pricing) and Laura (legal/procurement playbook) to help refine numbers and contract language. We'll propose a simple line-item table and two options: (A) Upfront PS fee + lower monthly, (B) PS fee converted to credits amortized over 12 months.

Next steps: Ben will send two concrete pricing scenarios by EOD tomorrow; Laura can draft a single-clause addendum for evidence-delivery SLAs. If Careline wants HSM seats, please confirm the desired region and expected number of tenant keys so we can size licensing.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachments: Careline_SOW_v1.pdf, SOC2-Snapshot-2025.zip
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@careline.health>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: packaging, credits, and evidence cadence

Elena — small follow-up with numbers so you have a concrete comparison for Procurement. See the two scenarios below (illustrative; final numbers subject to final commit sizing).

Scenario A — Upfront PS + lower monthly
- PS (onboarding, keying, evidence runbook): $45,000 one-time
- Audit log ingest & retention: $0.02 per GB-month (30 day default)
- KMS seat: $1,200 per key / month (managed KMS)
- HSM seat: $125,000 per year (customer-managed HSM subscription)
- Pilot credit: $22,500 (50% of PS) applied to invoice at activation
- Monthly recurring credit: $8,000/month for first 6 months

Scenario B — PS amortized into credits (12 months)
- PS: $45,000 converted to 12 monthly credits = $3,750/month offset
- Audit log / KMS / HSM unit prices same as above
- Monthly recurring credit: $4,500/month for first 12 months (blended with PS amortization)

Notes:
- We can cap audit log egress fees for the first 90 days of onboarding at no extra charge if you provide a signed LOI for Dedicated commits.
- HSM seat pricing can be tiered for multi-seat buys; Laura, please flag if we have any discounts in the >3 seat bucket we should propose.

Would you like these broken down into a per-line deal worksheet for Procurement? Happy to drop the numbers into HubSpot (I attached the draft worksheet to the deal).

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing_worksheet_Careline.csv (referenced)
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@careline.health>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Careline Procurement <procurement@careline.health>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons: packaging, credits, and evidence cadence

Thanks — this is helpful and clears up a lot. A couple quick clarifications from Procurement: 

1) For the HSM seat: Careline would prefer the annual subscription model if the discount for 2+ seats is available. Please confirm the threshold and the % discount for 2 and 5 seats.
2) For audit logs: can you confirm retention tiers (30 / 90 / 365) and whether the per-GB price above assumes hot vs cold storage pricing? Procurement will want both a 30-day and 365-day line item so they can model cost.
3) Evidence cadence: the SOC2 snapshot is good. For the week-by-week auditlog extracts during onboarding — Procurement requests that the first two weekly extracts be included in the pilot credit (so they don't incur excess egress costs).

If you can send the revised worksheet with the HSM multi-seat tiers and the three retention price lines, Procurement can review and aim to get a draft PO signed next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elena
